description: Open or add to a position: USDG approval (if needed) and create(collateral, tokens). Enforces the 11 USDG minimum for a new position, both caps and a fresh price. Returns UNSIGNED transaction data (to, data, value, gas) for the user's own wallet; simulated against the latest block first and refused if it would revert. Never signs or sends.

collateral.description: Collateral to deposit, in USDG as a decimal string, e.g. "11" or "25.5"

market.description: Market address (0x...) or symbol, e.g. NO-NVDA

mintTokens.description: Synth to mint ("0" for collateral only), in synth tokens as a decimal string, e.g. "0.0189"

owner.description: The user's wallet address (0x...). Used to read the position and as the simulated sender; nothing is signed.

name: prepare_create_position
title: Prepare create position
